title: Amazon: how to have the best product photos to boost your sales
h1: Amazon Product Image Optimization: A Complete Guide
metaTitle: Amazon photography: complete guide & automated solutions
description: Find out how to optimize your Amazon visuals according to official rules and boost your sales with Orbitvu automated photography.
author: Laurent Wainberg
content:
In the ultra-competitive world of Amazon, your visuals are not simple illustrations. They are your first selling point. According to some studies, nearly 75% of buyers make their purchase decisions based solely on product images, as explained eComo.
Here is a complete guide to understand The impact of visuals, the rules imposed by Amazon, and discover How to effectively automate image production, while controlling your costs and deadlines.

‍

‍

The decisive impact of visuals on your Amazon sales

Amazon is home to hundreds of thousands of sellers. In this context, your images should attract, convince and reassure, from the first seconds. Quality visuals can lead to up to 30% increase in conversion rate, according to eComo. It has an immediate effect on your sales... but also on your visibility in search results.
Amazon's algorithm favors listings that generate sales. The more your listing converts, the more it is highlighted, which generates more clicks and therefore, even more sales. A virtuous circle, fuelled largely by the quality of your visuals.
On Amazon, your photos should also compensate for the impossibility of handling the product. They must reassure, project the customer, reduce doubts. It is also an important lever for limit product returns, improve the perception of quality and differentiate themselves from similar products.

The rules you need to follow to comply with Amazon requirements

Amazon imposes strict technical specifications to ensure a consistent experience. These requirements apply to the main image as well as to the secondary visuals. Here are the main ones:

For all images:

‍

‍

  • Minimum size : 1000 pixels on the longest side to activate the zoom (Pixcap)
  • Recommended size : 1600 px or more
  • Ideal size : 2000 x 2000 px for a perfect square ratio
  • Accepted formats : JPEG (preferred), TIFF, PNG, non-animated GIFs
  • Color mode : RGB or CMYK (gray level is not accepted)
  • Image quality : clear, without pixelation or irregular edges

‍

‍

For the main image:

  • Pure white background required (RGB value: 255, 255, 255) (David Himbert)
  • The product should occupy 85% to 90% of the frame
  • No cropping, the product must be visible in its entirety
  • Prohibition to add text, logo or watermark
  • No accessories not included in the sale
  • No visible mannequin, except for clothing if authorized

‍

‍

For secondary images:

  • Up to 9 images in total, 7 of which are visible by default
  • Authorized simulation, as well as alternative funds
  • Possibility to add explanatory texts or infographics
  • Videos and 360° animations highly recommended

Failure to comply with these rules may result in temporary deletion of your product sheet, which immediately stops your sales. The return online is not immediate, and you lose positioning on the marketplace.

Expert tips to go even further

In addition to the classic recommendations (multiply the angles, zoom in on the details, add context), two axes deserve your attention:

Optimize for visual SEO

  • Rename your images with product keywords

faqs.question: What are Amazon's product image requirements?
faqs.answer: Amazon imposes strict rules: pure white background (RGB 255, 255, 255) for the main image, product taking up 85% of the frame, no logo, text, or accessories not included. The images must be in JPEG, TIFF, PNG, or GIF format, with a minimum size of 1000 x 1000 pixels to activate the zoom, and of impeccable quality. Up to 9 images are allowed, including lifestyle visuals, zooms, infographics, videos or 360° animations. Failure to meet these criteria may result in the temporary deletion of your product sheet.

faqs.question: What is the best strategy to optimize my product gallery on Amazon?
faqs.answer: Start by taking care of your main image: it is it that triggers the click. Then, make the most of the available locations to present your product from every angle. Integrate lifestyle images, add explanatory texts on the benefits of the product, zoom in on the details and offer a demonstration of use in images. The objective: to reassure, convince and allow the customer to project themselves from the first impression.

faqs.question: Are lifestyle images really effective on Amazon?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lifestyle visuals create an emotional connection with the customer. They allow you to show your product in a real situation, in a natural environment, which facilitates projection and reinforces the desire to buy. These images humanize your product sheet and make you stand out from competitors who are content with classic studio views.

faqs.question: Why is an automated photo studio more beneficial than an external photographer?
faqs.answer: An automated photo studio allows you to produce high-quality visuals in-house, quickly, without depending on service providers or sacrificing visual consistency. You maintain total control over the final result, reduce unit production costs and save considerable time. It is also the simplest solution for creating 360° animations or videos, even without photo expertise.

faqs.question: How can I concretely measure the impact of my visuals on my Amazon sales?
faqs.answer: Monitor your click-through rate (CTR) on the listings, your conversion rate, and your return volume. Improving your visuals — especially the main image — can have an immediate effect on performance. Experiment with different approaches, analyze results in Seller Central, and adjust continuously. A good visual is often the difference between a product that takes off... and another that is stagnating.
